name: Slack
description: Read channels, post messages, and search workspace history from your agent.
notes: Slack's official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.slack.com/mcp) acts as the authorizing user and serves only internal or Slack Marketplace apps that have the MCP server feature enabled; workspace admins can approve and manage them. The OAuth option reaches it with confidential OAuth (the app's client ID and secret; Slack has no dynamic client registration), and the user-token option sends a user token from your own Slack app. No third-party stdio server is shipped.

auth.credentialHelp: In your [Slack app](https://api.slack.com/apps), turn on Slack Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server under Agents and add user token scopes such as channels:history, channels:read, chat:write, reactions:write, search:read.public, and users:read ([scopes per tool](https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/#oauth-scopes)). Install the app (a workspace admin may need to approve it) and copy the User OAuth Token from OAuth & Permissions. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

installHint: Use Slack's official hosted MCP server. Create or choose a Slack app (internal or Marketplace-listed) with the Slack MCP server feature enabled, add user token scopes such as channels:history, channels:read, chat:write, reactions:write, search:read.public, and users:read, install it (a workspace admin may need to approve it), then paste the User OAuth Token below. See https://docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/.
